description: Defines a template class 'OptionalType' providing optional value semantics, including constructors, assignment operators, comparison operators, and utility methods for managing an optional value of type 'TYPE'.

classes.name: OptionalType
classes.description: A template class implementing an optional value container with methods for setting, clearing, and comparing the contained value.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator for copying from another OptionalType.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Move assignment operator for transferring value from another OptionalType.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator for assigning a value of type 'TYPE'.

methods.name: IsSet
methods.description: Checks if the optional value is set.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Resets the optional value to unset state.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Accesses the contained value (non-const and const versions).
